name: Suri's brother
desc:
[Suri](entity:suri)'s brother was a Vesperian.

He eventually passed and was laid to rest on the [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils). The [Well-kept Gravestone](entity:well_kept_gravestone) is where he was laid to rest. Not much is known about him besides owning rare Mantra ingredients.
